location_exception_reason: Security cabins are standardised prefabricated units sold nationwide; location of manufacture or deployment does not alter product specifications, functionality, or buyer decision-making. No GI protection or regional origin significance applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PUF Panel Security Cabin Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product description. The product is the cabin, not the business relationship.
